expected_behavior: A strong borewell pump match may be recommended; the reference and product intent should agree. No unrelated standard should become primary.
source_text_for_pdf: Supply and commissioning of 7.5 HP submersible pump sets for 180 mm agricultural bore wells, rated 415 V three phase, 50 Hz, 72 m head and 6 L/s discharge for a village water scheme. Require performance acceptance testing and conformity to IS 8034:2018.
